title: Notify the EPA of contaminated land
what: Notify the authority in writing of land contamination that presents, or is likely to present, a significant risk of harm.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1997 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 23A(1) (current republication (R70, from 16 November 2025; Environment Protection Act 1997 | Acts))
sources.quote: A relevant person in relation to land must notify the authority, in writing, as soon as practicable after becoming aware that the land is contaminated in such a way as to present, or to be likely to present— (a) a significant risk of harm

reach.condition: if it is a relevant person for land contaminated so as to present a significant risk of harm
